set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 7. Bind the same migrated representation to NeuroArchive Zarr or an admitted typed Zarr fixture, add dense identity support, adapt existing Zarr receipts into axis-keyed capability evidence, run the cross-backend laws, and test transactional Zarr publication. Acceptance: one logical decoder runs unchanged through memory, LNA, and Zarr with only binding/executor differences; backend agreement uses DecodeConsistency; dense Zarr obeys exact dense laws; browser and JVM plans and request traces agree; mixed-axis ChunkBounded/ByteRangeBounded claims conform to receipts; every coarser fallback is explicit; injected write failure never publishes; the frozen numerical corpus remains green. Stop and block all Track-D work if the unchanged-decoder proof fails.
